clue.text: Actor's application as agent ripe for review

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An agent's job application looks ripe for review by the casting people.
explanation.definitionFit: Make-up applied by stage performers before a show is the classic theatrical cosmetic.

clue.text: A bit of beluga — strictly for the stomach!

indicators.note: only a piece of the run of letters across these words is taken

explanation.surface: A spoonful of caviar strictly as a treat for the belly.
explanation.walkthrough: Beluga is a sturgeon whose roe is prized caviar.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means relating to the stomach, as in gastric juices.

clue.text: First hotel lacking in stature for boat crew

indicators.note: the stature word is missing the named letter

parts.note: height is stature

indicators.note: First picks just the opening letter of the word hotel

explanation.surface: The leading hotel is short on grandeur when hosting rowers.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing rowing boat with eight oarsmen, and so its crew, is called by this number.

clue.text: Stock lost from time under psychiatrist

indicators.note: in a down answer, the time piece is placed beneath the other

parts.note: shrink is slang for a psychiatrist
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Losses of stock from time spent under a psychiatrist's care.
explanation.definitionFit: In retail the term means goods lost to theft or waste, so stock that has gone missing.

clue.text: Factory dropping line is blow

indicators.note: the factory word lets go of one letter

parts.note: a plant is a factory

explanation.surface: A factory dropping a production line is a blow to the town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blow' looks like a noun meaning setback but is the verb, to puff.
explanation.definitionFit: To breathe hard and quickly is to puff or blow.

clue.text: Spoilt broadcast supporting independent politician

indicators.note: in a down answer, the supporting piece goes beneath the others

parts.note: MP, Member of Parliament, is a politician
aired means broadcast

explanation.surface: A broadcast backing an independent politician was ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: Damaged or weakened, as in impaired vision, means spoilt.

clue.text: Pitfalls of role set up with son

indicators.note: in a down answer, setting up means the word for role reads upwards

parts.note: a part is an actor's role

explanation.surface: The pitfalls of a part arranged with one's son.
explanation.definitionFit: Traps and pitfalls are both hidden dangers to catch the unwary.

clue.text: Completed short composition for two later than expected

parts.note: over means finished or completed

indicators.note: short means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a duet is a piece of music for two performers

explanation.surface: A short duet was finished later than planned.
explanation.definitionFit: Something late or past its due time, such as a library book, is overdue.

clue.text: Incitement without professional calling

indicators.note: without means the incitement word lacks the named piece

parts.note: provocation is incitement
pro is short for professional

explanation.surface: Stirring others up is no professional's true calling.
explanation.definitionFit: A calling is a strong sense of purpose for a particular career.

clue.text: Such a vegetable sweetens sleep!

parts.note: to sweeten tea is to sugar it; third person gives sugars
a nap is a short sleep

explanation.surface: An exclamation that a certain vegetable makes your sleep sweeter.
explanation.definitionFit: A sugar snap is a variety of pea with edible pods, an example of a vegetable.

clue.text: Address a chap with energy

parts.note: bod is informal British slang for a person or chap
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Someone addresses a fellow who is full of energy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Address' looks like a verb but is the noun: where one lives.
explanation.definitionFit: A home or residence is one's address in the sense of the place one lives.

clue.text: Stout barrel pinched by staff

indicators.note: the barrel is squeezed between the ends of the staff, so it sits inside

parts.note: a rod is a staff or stick
a tun is a large cask or barrel

explanation.surface: A barrel of stout beer is pilfered by the pub staff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stout' suggests the dark beer next to 'barrel', but it means plump.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe a plump, round-bodied person, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Treatment needed if dart is misdirected?

indicators.note: a dart sent off course goes astray, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A darts player's wild throw hits someone who now needs patching up.
explanation.definitionFit: Emergency care given on the spot to an injured person is a kind of medical treatment.

clue.text: Menswear item may be a tax on credit

indicators.note: in an across answer, the words placed on credit come after it

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit
VAT, value added tax, is the British sales tax

explanation.surface: Buying a piece of men's clothing on credit might attract a tax.
explanation.definitionFit: A neckerchief worn by men, tucked inside an open collar, is an item of menswear.

clue.text: Union giving everybody a nice woolly

parts.note: all means everybody

indicators.note: woolly means fuzzy or confused, so the letters are muddled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A union gives every member a nice woolly jumper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'woolly' looks like a noun, the jumper, but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A pact between nations or parties is a union of interests.

clue.text: Exhibit signs of exertion seeing column on exercise runs

indicators.note: in an across answer, the column placed on the other pieces follows them

parts.note: PE, physical education, is school exercise
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for runs
a spire is a tall tapering column on a church

explanation.surface: A runner seeing the column on their exercise route starts to show the strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweating is the visible sign of physical exertion.

clue.text: Plan to make great pastry dishes rise

indicators.note: in a down answer, rising means the pieces read upwards

parts.note: mega is slang for great
tarts are pastry dishes

explanation.surface: A baker's plan to make great pastries rise.
explanation.definitionFit: A ruse or scheme is a plan devised to gain an advantage.

clue.text: Holding supplies of raised beds with family arriving at last

indicators.note: in a down answer, raised means the word for beds reads upwards

parts.note: cots are small beds
kin means family

indicators.note: the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Raised beds and the family finally turn up with supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A shop keeping goods on hand is stocking them, holding supplies.

clue.text: Singing style's artificial with exaggerated backing

parts.note: false means fake or artificial

indicators.note: backing means the word for exaggerated is read in reverse

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means exaggerated

explanation.surface: A singer's style is mocked as artificial, with over-the-top accompaniment.
explanation.definitionFit: A high voice above a man's normal range is a vocal technique, so a style of singing.

clue.text: Heat regularly seen in sheep or horse's joint

indicators.note: the picked letters appear inside the sheep word

parts.note: a flock is a group of sheep

indicators.note: every other letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Heat shows up in a sheep's or horse's joint.
explanation.definitionFit: The projection on the back of a horse's leg above the hoof is a joint of the limb.

clue.text: Cost protecting new member of royal dynasty

indicators.note: the cost wraps round the other letter as if shielding it

parts.note: price means cost

explanation.surface: The expense of guarding a fresh royal recruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A king's son is a male member of a royal house.

clue.text: Showing no sign of finishing, tip not so much

parts.note: an end is a tip
less means not so much

explanation.surface: A waiter grumbles that the tip seems to get smaller without end.
explanation.definitionFit: Something interminable shows no sign of stopping or finishing.

clue.text: Conduct diplomacy including managed source of secrecy

indicators.note: the diplomacy word takes the other pieces inside itself

parts.note: tact is diplomacy in dealing with people
ran means managed, as in ran a business

indicators.note: the source of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Diplomats conduct their business with tact and a measure of secrecy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Conduct' looks like a noun, behaviour, but is the verb meaning carry out.
explanation.definitionFit: To conduct business is to carry it out, the verb sense of a deal being done.

clue.text: Be of use and dish up

definitions.meaning: to ... a purpose is to be useful
to put food on plates for diners

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to be useful and to present food.

clue.text: Designed pen given by the French centre in Cadiz

clue.text: Find out Labour's beginning to work for money

indicators.note: the beginning of the party name is its first letter

parts.note: to earn is to work for money

explanation.surface: Labour's early aim was to find a way to work for money.

clue.text: Good man needing a good party

parts.note: ST, saint, is a good man

explanation.definitionFit: A stag is a groom's pre-wedding party, an example of a celebration.

clue.text: NATO's last award?

clue.text: Fuse molten granite alien's turned over

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Molten granite fuses as a space alien is turned over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' says the film alien's letters read backwards, as TE, and they sit in the middle of the melted rock's rearranged letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To fuse things is to merge or combine them into one whole.

clue.text: Battles to make dates

explanation.surface: Fighting it out in order to secure romantic outings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both clashes between armies and arranged appointments.
